summary: Wooden fire tower at Pine Hill, Potter County, about 20 feet tall, in use around 1917 and no longer standing; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says no longer standing; no removal date in the sources

events.note: Erected before 1917, per the Department of Forestry report of December 31, 1917 quoted on the weebly page; no exact year given
Register says the tower was used circa 1917
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

evidence.supports: Wooden tower used circa 1917, no longer standing
evidence.quote: This wooden tower was used circa 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: The entry comes from a Department of Forestry report of December 31, 1917
evidence.quote: Report of the Department of Forestry, December 31, 1917

sources.title: Pine Hill Tower Site (Potter County)
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Both sources are brief listings. The build date is only 'before 1917'; the built event has no year (null) and the note says so. The register says 'No coordinates are available', so the brief's lat/lon (41.60549, -77.87034) has no source among the pages read. No removal date, present-day description or access information was found.
